Core data access layer for memory CRUD operations using ObjectBox database. Supports per-profile isolation. Implements vector similarity search with RRF (Reciprocal Rank Fusion) combining semantic and keyword search. Includes link graph operations (strong/medium/weak relations), tag system, document chunk management, folder-based organization, and memory import/export.

Core memory unit entity stored in ObjectBox. Represents a knowledge fragment/event/concept. Contains title, content, contentType, source, credibility, importance, documentPath, isDocumentNode, chunkIndexFilePath, folderPath, embedding (FloatArray), tags, links, backlinks, properties, documentChunks, and timestamps.
Directed relationship between memories with weight (strong/medium/weak) and description. Forms a knowledge graph.
Tag for memory classification with parent-child hierarchy support
HNSWLib-based vector index. Uses cosine similarity distance. Supports dynamic resizing, item removal, k-nearest-neighbor query, persistence via Java serialization to disk.
Concrete Item implementation for HNSWLib storing id, vector (FloatArray), and associated data

High-level memory management API. Analyzes conversation content via AI to extract structured knowledge graph: entities (ParsedEntity), relationships (ParsedLink), updates (ParsedUpdate), merges (ParsedMerge), and user preferences. Persists extracted knowledge as memory nodes with links in ObjectBox.

Periodic background service that scans chat histories for memory-worthy content. Polls every 60s, extracts candidates from conversations (reply finalization, user messages), batches them (max 48 messages/run), and processes via MemoryAutoSaveCandidateRepository.
